suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific temporal risk. Apply only to documented cerebral malaria, predominantly pediatric populations consistent with the evidence, followed by separately diagnosed epilepsy. Do not generalize to uncomplicated malaria or isolated acute febrile/provoked seizures. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Malaria matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Epilepsy with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors

Resolution of the publication guard: Apply only to documented cerebral malaria, predominantly pediatric populations consistent with the evidence, followed by separately diagnosed epilepsy. Do not generalize to uncomplicated malaria or isolated acute febrile/provoked seizures.
